column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the oracle” is rendered “The burden,” and “by the hand of Malachi” “by Malachi.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for Edom will say” is rendered “Even though Edom has said,” “we have been shattered” “We have been impoverished,” and “was indignant” “will have indignation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from over the border” is rendered “beyond the border.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a father … a master” used of God is rendered “the Father … a Master,” capitalized, and “my fear” “My reverence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will he lift up your face” is rendered “Would he accept you favorably?”
Close to the Hebrew; “entreat the face of God” is rendered “entreat God’s favor,” and “from your hand was this” “While this is being done by your hands.”
NKJV renders the present “my name [is] great … incense is offered” as future, “My name shall be great … incense shall be offered,” and “the nations” first as “the Gentiles.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you sniff at it” is rendered “you sneer at it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the one who deals deceptively” is rendered “the deceiver.”
